key_points.text: My guest this week is Jane McGonagall.
key_points.evidence_quote: My guest this week is Jane McGonagall, who is a world-renowned designer of alternate reality games or games that are designed to improve real lives and solve real problems.

thesis: Jane McGonigal argues that modern video games have shifted from competitive formats to massively collaborative experiences that place players in a 'flow state' between boredom and being overwhelmed. She posits that this state fosters personal development by allowing players to master micro-skills and eventually apply those problem-solving abilities to real-life challenges.
